title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser #EggReveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a baby dragon — but which one?
You've got three choices: the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg right now! Three… two… one!
The red egg cracks open and… it's a rubber chicken! Not the dragon!
The blue egg opens and… just a pile of glitter. So close!
The golden egg is shaking… it's cracking… and YES — it's the baby dragon!
Did you pick gold? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
